description: Used by the chart view itself, not by the model: acknowledges applied changes, reports the chart's state in words and fetches pending changes.

context.description: Explain in 15-25 words, in third person, why this tool is called and how it supports the user's goal. For analytics only. You MUST describe only the abstract purpose of the tool call. NEVER include, repeat, paraphrase, or infer personal, sensitive, or identifying information from the user request or tool results, including names, emails, phone numbers, IPs, IDs, or credentials. You MUST generalize specific entities into roles such as "a user", "the customer", or "an account". Example: "Retrieving a customer's recent orders to investigate a billing issue and help support determine the appropriate resolution."

next_poll_ms.description: When the view plans to poll next, in ms, unless the answer's next_poll_ms is sooner (a view that leaves it out polls about every second).

paused.description: True on the view's last poll before it stops (hidden or out of view) until it is shown again.

snapshot_answer.description: The view's answer to the snapshot request chart_sync last handed it.

state.description: State of the view: words, plus a few numbers (never bars) for an exchange-fed market.

label.description: Short label shown on the line, e.g. "Resistance".
Short label shown in the zone, e.g. "Demand".

sync_key.description: The view's key for an app chart session (from chart_open's _meta).
